```{r setup, include=FALSE}
devtools::install_github("vibonvallet/linregpack")
library(linregpack)
```

## Overview
This vignette demonstrates the basic usage of the linregpack package, which provides a simple implementation of ordinary least squares (OLS) linear regression. The example compares linregpack’s linreg_fit() function to the base R lm() function using the classic iris dataset. The vignette shows how to fit a simple linear regression model and verify that the coefficients match those produced by lm().

## Usage
```{r}
fit_lr <- linreg_fit(Sepal.Length ~ Sepal.Width, data=iris)
fit_lm <- lm(Sepal.Length ~ Sepal.Width, data=iris)
all.equal(coef(fit_lr), coef(fit_lm))
```

## Notes
- linreg_fit() is a lightweight alternative to lm().
- The all.equal() function confirms that the coefficients from linreg_fit() are identical (or numerically very close) to those from lm().
